description: Get all pins waiting for developer attention. Returns three categories: (1) "auto-agent" — pins explicitly sent to the agent via "Send to Agent"; (2) "follow-up" — previously implemented pins with new user comments; (3) "review" — open reviewer comments that a developer has not yet picked up (the standard team collaboration queue). Use this as your starting point for both auto-agent workflows and manual review sessions.

mentionedUser.description: Optional username to filter by @mention. Returns only pins where the thread contains "@username". Leading @ is optional (e.g. "josh" or "@josh").

mode.description: Optional filter to return only pins of a specific mode. Omit to return all.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to filter by. Without projectId it uses the folder's default project: the one set with --project-id / PINCUSHION_PROJECT_ID, else the one confirmed with confirm_project_setup for this folder and the signed-in account, else the single project auto-discovered by URL; with none of those it reads every project. If the folder's selection file exists but cannot be read, it returns setup_selection_unreadable instead of reading.
